# Acme's INV-A and Beta's INV-B, 100.00 CAD each, and one 100.00 deposit that
# settles INV-B. The deposit's bank split carries the memo "Deposit", which is
# what a payment block states to say which movement it is about.
#
# What this fixture produces: INV-A outstanding, INV-B settled by the deposit,
# and the deposit's receivable split in INV-B's lot.
#
# Load after `payment_roundtrip_accounts.txt`.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_a_payment_stating_a_guid_that_matches_nothing_is_refused_where_the_deposits_owner_cannot_be_read.py.
customer "C001"
	name: "Acme"
	currency: CAD

customer "C002"
	name: "Beta"
	currency: CAD

2026-01-15 * "Deposit"
	guid: "a4a4a4a4a4a4a4a4a4a4a4a4a4a4a4a4"
	Assets:Bank 100.00 CAD
		guid: "b5b5b5b5b5b5b5b5b5b5b5b5b5b5b5b5"
		memo: "Deposit"
	Assets:Accounts Receivable -100.00 CAD
		guid: "c6c6c6c6c6c6c6c6c6c6c6c6c6c6c6c6"

invoice "INV-A"
	customer_id: "C001"
	currency: CAD
	date_opened: 2026-01-01
	entry:
		date: 2026-01-01
		description: "Service"
		action: "Hours"
		account: "Income:Sales"
		quantity: 1
		price: 100
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
	posted:
		date: 2026-01-01
		due: 2026-01-31
		ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable"
		memo: "Invoice INV-A"
		accumulate: true

invoice "INV-B"
	customer_id: "C002"
	currency: CAD
	date_opened: 2026-01-01
	entry:
		date: 2026-01-01
		description: "Service"
		action: "Hours"
		account: "Income:Sales"
		quantity: 1
		price: 100
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
	posted:
		date: 2026-01-01
		due: 2026-01-31
		ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable"
		memo: "Invoice INV-B"
		accumulate: true
	payment:
		date: 2026-01-15
		amount: 100
		bank_account: "Assets:Bank"
		txn_guid: "a4a4a4a4a4a4a4a4a4a4a4a4a4a4a4a4"
		txn_split_guid: "c6c6c6c6c6c6c6c6c6c6c6c6c6c6c6c6"
